messages:
erin: Pilot customer B wants a clear acceptance rubric for multi-region routing with tenant isolation. Can someone produce a short checklist we can hand to AMs? @diego @meera

diego: I'll take it. Keep it bite-sized: Preconditions, Tests to pass, Observability, Kill-switch & Rollback, Signoffs.

meera: Ops items: define "acceptable spill" percent, require a 24h warmup run, and KV-cache evacuation SLA (target <30s). Also need required burst buffer (e.g., 30% over peak).

erin: Draft for AM handoff below. One-liner bullets so sales can skim.

erin: ```text
Multi-region routing: pilot acceptance checklist
1) Preconditions: KMS & ADP enabled, residency flags set, SLA tier selected
2) Allowed spillover: <=5% by default (customer can opt-in higher)
3) Burst capacity: reserve +30% of expected peak for 15m
4) KV evacuation objective: <30s to drain active windows
5) Validation tests: 1h live smoke with customer prompts; 10m simulated 5% cross-region spill
6) Quality gate: prompt-set regression <5% vs baseline
7) Observability: p50/p90/p99, token_cost, error_rate, kv-evac-time visible in console
8) Kill-switch: immediate disable cross-region fallback on p99 >2x baseline or regression >5%
9) Signoffs: product + ops + legal (residency review) before enabling
```

meera: Adding: post-enable 48h burn-in monitoring and a follow-up debrief with AMs.

legal: Note: any cross-region fallback for EU/CA customers requires explicit contract language. We'll prepare a short clause.

ops-bot: Run scheduled: spill-sim-01 planned for 2024-04-05T02:00Z

derin: Thanks all  I'll convert to a one-pager and share with pilot AMs. If no objections by EOW, we'll mark as approved.
